title: French Chicken Tarte Tatin
description: A twist on the classic Tarte Tatin, this recipe features juicy chicken and a rich, caramelized sauce.

ingredients.name: tarte tatin apples
ingredients.notes: a mix of sweet and tart apples

instructions: Peel, core, and halve the apples.
In a large skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat.
Add the halved apples and cook until caramelized, about 10 minutes.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt.
Add the sugar, beaten egg, and heavy cream to the bowl and whisk until smooth.
Arrange the chicken breasts on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the chicken with the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter.
Transfer the skillet with the apples to the oven and bake for 10 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and brush the top of the chicken with the apple mixture.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake for an additional 10-12 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Serve the chicken with the caramelized apples and sauce spooned over the top.
